soul_corrections.current_text: The Bearzooka is drawn as a green, hazard-striped tube [Observed; Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: The BBG Bearzooka is a coral-red hexagonal tube with glowing orange panels, grey hex collars and a grey checker band on the flared muzzle [Observed, 2012-13 in-game and the 2026 trailer], matching the wiki's 'red and orange lines' [Fan-wiki]. The green, hazard-striped 'BEARZOOKA' tube is the BB Zombies (2009) design [Observed, File:Bear.jpg].
soul_corrections.evidence: File:BBR Bearzooka.png (store, Mar 2012), File:Photo 19-04-13 12 02 26 PM.png, official Steam trailer about 3.6-5.0 s (local crop /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/oliver-final/crops/tr_bz.jpg), File:Bear.jpg ('Weapon Selected: BEARZOOKA', BBZ); wiki Bearzooka page: 'In BBG and BB0, it is a rocket launcher with red and orange lines. In BBZ and BB-1 it is just a dark green rocket launcher.'

soul_corrections.current_text: He also has an improvised katana [Canon, channel unconfirmed] ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P6z5l7toC3w)).
soul_corrections.correction: Add the era: this is the BB-1 (2010) Katana. The BBG equivalent is the Kumakiri melee (BBR v1.3.2, level 30), whose text 'It's baaack!' refers to it [Fan-wiki].
soul_corrections.evidence: Kumakiri wiki page: 'The description refers to the [[Katana]] used by [[Oliver]] in [[Battle Bears -1]].'; File:Sword.png (BB-1 art of Oliver slicing a red Huggable).

soul_corrections.current_text: A green-and-dark-grey harness with grey clips [Observed] and a small green backpack [Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: Mark the harness as older 2D art only (2012 card, BB-1, File:Sw_boots.png). For the BBG in-game default: a team-coloured headband, wristbands and knee bands with silver-ringed buttons, a crossed bandolier of brass cartridges on team-coloured straps, and a pale grey-lavender hexagonal backpack plate [Observed; Fan-wiki Skins 'all coloured to the team'].
soul_corrections.evidence: File:Photo 19-04-13 12 02 36 PM.png and the other 2013 item photos; File:SoldierOliver.jpg ('OLIVER v4' turnaround, Nov 2012); Soldier (BBG)/Skins: 'featuring a bandana, arm and leg bands, and ammo straps, all coloured to the team. As with all characters, also a unique backpack.'

soul_corrections.current_text: Using the lighter #AB7A52 for the muzzle is a BBG News pick, as are the unsampled harness green #4E6B35, strap grey #3A3D40, clips #8E949A and nose #1B1B1B [BBG News invention].
soul_corrections.correction: For BBG framing drop the harness, strap and clip colours. Use these sampled gear colours instead: headband about #9D010E (red team), cartridges about #EBD37B, backpack about #776A7D. Note that in-game fur samples about #2E120A under arena light, darker than the BBH-sampled #794B35 [Observed].
soul_corrections.evidence: Median samples I took today from File:Photo 19-04-13 12 02 36 PM.png (local /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/oliver-final/png/Photo_19-04-13_12_02_36_PM.png).
